clo.clo1: Show mathematical and scientific skills and knowledge on the fundamental concepts of Physics, including mechanics.
clo.clo2: Manifest skills in carrying out designated tasks needed for gaining knowledge in different areas of Physics.
clo.clo3: Manifest thinking and writing skills in accomplishing written and virtual outputs from designated tasks.

w1-lesson.title: Can We Trust What We Measure?
steps: Click through every slide to the end. The counter shows how many are left.
Take notes on the examples. You will use them in the Activity.
When you reach the last slide, continue to the Activity.

w1-activity.title: Measurement Quick Check
w1-activity.covers: Scientific method, units, accuracy vs precision, Weber’s Law
steps: Join the Teams class meeting below when your instructor posts the schedule.
Answer all 5 questions. You see feedback right after each answer.
Press Submit answers at the end. You cannot move on until you finish.

w1-quiz.title: Formative Quiz: Physics Foundations
steps: Answer all 8 questions. Use the calculator on your device for the computation items.
You see feedback after each answer, so read the explanation before moving on.
Press Submit answers at the end to finish the week.
